instruction: Place an order for all weightlifting benches in my amazon cart.
notes: Task is a cart-filtering order: keep only weightlifting-bench items in the amazon cart, then place one order. The cart contents are unknown up front, so the problem uses placeholder products (2 benches, 3 non-bench items, matching the 10-call reference); at runtime the agent reads amazon.show_cart and binds each non-bench entry's product_id. Because STRIPS cannot express 'no unwanted item remains', the number of non-bench items is encoded as discrete count objects (three -> two -> one -> zero, `count-pred`); each delete_product_from_cart decrements the counter and place_order requires the counter at the domain constant `zero`. Deleting a bench item is forbidden (precondition `(not (is-weightlifting-bench ?p))`), so the order contains exactly the benches with their existing cart quantities. The address and payment card ids are looked up via amazon.show_addresses / amazon.show_payment_cards (existing records, no address added or changed). complete_task takes no answer; the `?o - order` parameter is just the created record so its precondition mirrors the goal. If show_cart did not expose product_type, amazon.show_product per entry could be used but is not modeled.
